The core: use cases, the ports they depend on and the seat rules. No Django, no Celery.
Locks the workshop, confirms a seat
or joins the waitlist. Repeating it
Cancels a registration. A freed seat
Fills free seats from the waitlist,
What the use cases need from
free seats, the status of a new
The one place that picks concrete
classes. Builds a fresh use case with
its own unit of work for each call.
